capabilities: Track belongings with price, purchase/end dates, tags, and recycle value in TOML note frontmatter
Compute daily cost per item and render a cost trend chart with totals
Filter, search, and sort items by tag, name, daily cost, price, or purchase date
Add, edit, and delete items in place from a card UI
extras: Installation is only via BRAT or manual release download; the README notes no marketplace listing and states the plugin works fully offline with no network use.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage personal belongings as structured cost data with computed daily cost and trend views.
summary: Inventory tracker that stores belongings as TOML-in-Markdown notes and shows totals, filtering, and a daily cost trend chart in a dedicated view.
